authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 472 identifies Hindi cehrā with Persian cehra, defined as face on p. 461. The existing Hindi cehra attestation provides the immediate regional donor hypothesis; surveyed expanded and contracted cehr- face forms retain uncertain intervening local transmission. Exact source form cehara is preserved. The donor locality is an attestation, not an assertion of historical transmission from that village.
